description: The franchise manager's cat got out and she's inconsolable and paying. Look for 'Mister Pockets' along Voss Avenue, out into Residential Area, and back through Marrow Street. Everyone knows how this ends. 10₵.
name: Lost Cat

emotes: {who} crouches to peer under a bench on Voss Avenue, calling 'Mister Pockets?' softly.
{who} shakes a little bag of kibble and listens for a hopeful jingle that doesn't come.
{who} finds a cat. Wrong cat. Furious cat. {who} moves on, bleeding slightly.
{who} works the Kessler Street corner, checking every gap a small warm thing could hide in.
{who} whistles for a cat in a place where whistling attracts worse than cats.
{who} spots a suspicious tuft of fur, follows it, and decides not to investigate the smell.
{who} works Marrow Street gutters, quieter now, hopes lowering with the light.
{who} calls 'Mister Pockets' one last time into Marrow Street and gets only an echo.
{who} decides to tell the manager he 'ran off somewhere nice,' pockets the fee, and calls it a mercy.
